message.content: On September 7th, 2026, AdamSmith specifically asked LiHua about the basement to inquire about any potential issues related to water leakage following a recent storm. In the conversation, LiHua assured AdamSmith that the basement was in good condition, noting only a bit of dampness without major problems. AdamSmith expressed relief that there was no leakage and offered to assist LiHua if she needed any support with the basement or if she intended to use it for storage purposes. This indicates that AdamSmith was concerned about the structural integrity of the basement and wanted to ensure that it was safe and suitable for LiHua's use.
